Description: Platform Foundation & Infrastructure. Level 1 launch-core epic for Prime Wrist BD. 8 tasks, 28 story points.
Monorepo, TypeScript strict config, ESLint/Prettier, commit hooks, branch protection.
App Router project, routing shell, layout primitives, environment config, image loader.
Postgres + Prisma. Core entities: user, product, variant, inventory, cart, order, payment, shipment.
Separate dev/staging/prod secrets. No gateway keys in the repo. Rotation procedure documented.
Automated build, typecheck, test, and preview deploys. Staging mirrors prod config.
Production hosting, primeswristbd domain, TLS certificate, CDN in front of static assets.
Sentry for server + client exceptions, uptime check on the checkout route specifically.
Typography scale, colour tokens, spacing, button/input/card primitives. Prevents Level 2 rework.
Identity & Access. Level 1 launch-core epic for Prime Wrist BD. 5 tasks, 19 story points.
Signup, login, hashed credentials, session handling via secure httpOnly cookies.
SMS OTP via a BD-capable provider. Phone is the primary identity for most Bangladeshi buyers.
Tokenised reset link with expiry, plus OTP fallback for phone-first accounts.
Purchase without account creation, with optional post-purchase account claim.
Profile, saved addresses, order history entry point.
Watch Catalog Data Model. Level 1 launch-core epic for Prime Wrist BD. 6 tasks, 24 story points.
Product with variants on strap/dial/case where applicable; SKU, price, compare-at price, stock.
Structured specs: brand, movement (automatic/quartz/solar), case diameter, case material, dial colour, crystal, strap material, water resistance rating, warranty term.
Brand entities with logo, description, and country of origin; collections for merchandising.
Multi-angle image upload, ordering, responsive renditions, WebP/AVIF output. Watches sell on imagery.
Stock per variant, reservation on order placement, oversell prevention.
Per-product warranty term, authorised-dealer flag, and serial/box-papers indicator. Central trust lever in watch retail.
Storefront Catalog Experience. Level 1 launch-core epic for Prime Wrist BD. 6 tasks, 26 story points.
Hero, featured collections, new arrivals, brand strip, trust bar.
Brand, category, and collection listings with pagination and consistent card component.
Gallery, price, variant selector, stock state, full specification table, warranty and authenticity block, add to cart.
Hover/pinch zoom and lightbox across multi-angle shots. Direct conversion driver for watches.
Case diameter to wrist size guidance and strap length reference. Cuts sizing-related returns.
About, authenticity policy, warranty, service and care.
Product Discovery. Level 1 launch-core epic for Prime Wrist BD. 4 tasks, 15 story points.
Postgres full-text search over title, brand, and specs with basic ranking.
Filter by brand, price range, movement type, case size band, and stock availability.
Price ascending/descending, newest, and popularity.
Shareable, indexable filtered URLs with correct canonical handling.
Cart, Currency & Shipping Rules. Level 1 launch-core epic for Prime Wrist BD. 5 tasks, 21 story points.
Server-persisted for logged-in users, cookie-based for guests. Quantity edit, remove, live subtotal.
BDT default with USD display for international visitors. FX source, refresh cadence, and rounding rules defined explicitly.
Inside Dhaka / outside Dhaka rate bands, free-shipping threshold, and delivery estimate.
Zone-based rates, weight bands, and a clear duties-and-taxes disclaimer at checkout.
Bangladesh VAT handling and tax-inclusive vs exclusive display rules.
Checkout & Payments. Level 1 launch-core epic for Prime Wrist BD. 9 tasks, 50 story points.
Address capture with Division / District / Upazila-Thana cascading selects, contact details, order review.
Cards plus mobile banking rails in a single BD gateway. Sandbox and production credentials.
Native bKash checkout as a distinct path; the dominant BD wallet and worth its own flow.
Card processing for overseas buyers with 3D Secure.
Alternative international method for markets where card trust is lower.
COD as a first-class payment method with eligibility rules by order value, location, and customer history.
Partial advance requirement above a value threshold, and a blocklist for repeat refusers. COD refusal is the largest margin leak in BD e-commerce.
Idempotent webhook handling, signature verification, and a daily settlement reconciliation report.
On-screen confirmation plus emailed and SMS receipt with order number and line items.
Order Management & Fulfilment. Level 1 launch-core epic for Prime Wrist BD. 7 tasks, 37 story points.
Order list, filters, detail view, and status transitions: pending, confirmed, packed, shipped, delivered, returned, cancelled.
Call-to-confirm queue with outcome logging before an order is released to a courier.
Pathao, Steadfast, or RedX API for consignment creation, label printing, and status sync.
DHL or FedEx booking with commercial invoice and HS code capture.
Order placed, confirmed, shipped, delivered, cancelled.
Order and delivery SMS. Higher open rate than email in this market.
Return request capture, admin approval, and refund execution across each payment method including COD.
Store Administration. Level 1 launch-core epic for Prime Wrist BD. 4 tasks, 21 story points.
Separate admin login with owner, manager, and fulfilment roles. MFA on owner accounts.
Create, edit, archive products, variants, specs, and media without developer involvement.
Manual stock corrections with an audit trail of who changed what.
Daily orders, revenue, COD vs prepaid split, and top products.
Trust, Legal & Compliance. Level 1 launch-core epic for Prime Wrist BD. 6 tasks, 17 story points.
Physical address, phone, WhatsApp, and email in header and footer. A documented trust signal, and doubly so for high-value watch purchases.
Terms & Conditions, Privacy Policy, Refund & Cancellation Policy, Warranty Policy, Shipping Policy.
Forced HTTPS, HSTS, secure cookie flags, and security headers.
All card entry hosted or redirected to the gateway so card data never reaches Prime Wrist BD servers.
Consent capture sized for international visitors under GDPR, not only domestic traffic.
Explicit sourcing, warranty, and counterfeit policy. The single highest-leverage trust asset for an online watch retailer.
Quality, Telemetry & Launch. Level 1 launch-core epic for Prime Wrist BD. 8 tasks, 42 story points.
Schema-level validation with graceful, specific errors across signup, address, and checkout.
Tap-friendly targets and tested layouts on low-end Android, which dominates BD traffic.
LCP, INP, and CLS thresholds enforced in CI, with image weight caps on the PDP gallery.
Full funnel: view_item, add_to_cart, begin_checkout, purchase, with payment method as a dimension.
Metadata, Product and Offer schema, XML sitemap, robots.txt, canonical rules.
Contrast, focus states, and keyboard path through the checkout. Cheap now, expensive at Level 2.
Full transaction-loop test across every payment method including a live low-value COD and a live card order.
Go-live sequence, DNS cutover, smoke tests, and a documented rollback trigger.
